summary: Review AI proposals, risk evidence and board oversight using practical governance tools. Explore the course and its board-focused outcomes.
lede: AI governance training for board members helps directors, board secretaries and senior executives assess AI proposals and oversee accountable use. Through board-focused exercises, you practise reviewing use-case inventories and risk evidence, clarifying ownership and escalation routes, and preparing dashboards, board papers and action plans; no programming is required.
audienceIntro: AI board oversight requires directors and advisers who can connect proposed use cases to accountable owners, risk evidence and board decisions. This course is designed for people who review, govern or report on AI use in their organisation.
modules: NIST AI RMF Board Risk Review
